mvp_description: Pet adoption matching platform for animal shelters and humane societies

top_buyers.name: Ashtabula County Animal Protective League (ACAPL)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Primary animal shelter serving Ashtabula County. A matching platform with detailed pet profiles and adoption applications would streamline their adoption process. Currently does not allow kennel walkthroughs to reduce dog stress - digital matching would be valuable.

top_buyers.name: Humane Society of Ashtabula County
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Local humane society handling pet adoptions and animal welfare in Ashtabula County. Digital tools for pet matching and volunteer coordination would support their mission. Listed as primary resource for reporting animal cruelty in Ashtabula County.

additional_contacts.name: Animal Welfare Center of Ashtabula (AWC)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Helps pets stay with their families during hardships. A matching platform could connect foster families with pets needing temporary homes.

additional_contacts.name: Petfinder (Ashtabula County Partners)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Already used by local shelters for pet listings. A local-focused matching tool could complement or enhance their current digital presence.

additional_contacts.name: PAWS Ohio (Public Animal Welfare Society)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: One of Ohio's most reputable no-kill rescues. Advanced matching algorithms and foster management tools would enhance their operations.

research_notes: ACAPL has verified contact info including email and hours. Humane Society email inferred from standard pattern - no direct email found on website. Both organizations are primary targets for pet adoption technology.
